scope: Exploratory historical associations and a research review-queue simulation; no causal or intervention-benefit claim

statistics.cohort: All SLA-eligible completed historical orders; unknown outcomes excluded explicitly

hypotheses.label: Distance >1,000 km vs <=500 km
hypotheses.definition: Fully geocoded baskets only; exclude the middle band

hypotheses.label: Two or more items vs one item
Any interstate seller vs all same-state
hypotheses.definition: All item seller/customer states must be known

statistics.method: Separate linear probability contrasts with purchase-month fixed effects and CR1 purchase-week clustered standard errors; two-sided Student t with G-1 df
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction over exactly four primary week-clustered p-values, alpha 0.05
statistics.sensitivity: Purchase-day clustered intervals; descriptive group rates and explicit exclusions
statistics.limits: Thresholds fixed for this analysis after prior exploration, not preregistered. Monthly adjustment is not full confounder control. Week clusters assume independence across weeks; repeat sellers/customers and longer serial dependence remain. Conditional on completed observed deliveries.

planner.input: Saved August approval-time scores; August has already been inspected and is a reused diagnostic
planner.batch: All previous calendar day's approvals; screen at 09:00 the next day, source timestamps as recorded
planner.known_completion_rule: Exclude only deliveries with a recorded delivered_at strictly before the screening cutoff; never inspect future status or late labels to select
planner.carryover: None. Each approval is offered once; unselected orders leave this simulation
planner.capacity_pool: Pooled team minutes, not an individual reviewer shift schedule
planner.cost_assumption: Illustrative review durations, not measured Olist staffing data; integer ceiling after sensitivity multiplier
planner.priority: 100 * (n - within-batch rank + 1) / n; raw model score descending, order ID breaks ties; no whole-August percentile used
planner.objective: Maximize sum of ordinal review-priority points under time, count and primary-seller limits; points are not calibrated expected late orders
planner.evaluation: Join nullable known outcomes only after selection. Unknown outcomes consume time and never become on-time labels. Compare realized counts descriptively; no tuning or policy choice using these results.
planner.limits: Model probabilities unreliable; ranking gain modest. No dispatch, fleet routing, prevented delays, causal uplift, monetary savings or production qualification. Seller cap is a declared concentration limit, not a fairness guarantee; it covers the primary seller only.
